framework_rationale: The solution genuinely uses TensorCircuit (`tensorcircuit as tc`) with its JAX backend (`tc.set_backend('jax')`, `tc.set_dtype('complex128')`) for all core quantum operations: `tc.quantum.PauliStringSum2MVP` constructs the analog and target Hamiltonian matrix-vector products, `tc.Circuit` prepares the Neel state and applies the per-qubit digital `rz`/`ry`/`rz` rotation layers, `tc.timeevol.ode_evol_global` performs the continuous-time ODE analog evolution, and `tc.backend` computes the energy expectation value. Only standard scientific/optimization libraries (`jax`, `numpy`, `optax`) are used alongside TensorCircuit, with no other quantum frameworks imported or used and no raw simulator bypass.
cheating_rationale: There are no hardcoded outputs, hidden answers, test or reward tampering, file I/O, or evaluator exploits. All parameters are initialized as specified and genuinely optimized via gradient descent, and the returned arrays are derived directly from the trained variational parameters and recorded per-step energies.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation faithfully matches all specifications in the problem statement: it reads and uses every config parameter (`n_qubits`, `n_blocks`, `t_min`, `t_max`, `ode_rtol`, `ode_atol`, `ode_max_steps`, `max_steps`, `learning_rate`); constructs the exact open-boundary target and analog Hamiltonians; starts from the `|0101...>` Neel state; runs `n_blocks` hybrid blocks using continuous-time ODE evolution (`tc.timeevol.ode_evol_global` with `rtol`, `atol`, and `max_steps`) rather than Trotterization, followed by `RZ(alpha) RY(beta) RZ(gamma)` rotations on every qubit; parameterizes `t_l`, `J_l`, and `Delta_l` via sigmoid and tanh with the prescribed initialization (`s_l=0`, `j_l=d_l=0.1`, rotation angles from `N(0, 0.1^2)`); minimizes `<H_target> / n_qubits` for exactly `max_steps` Adam updates at `learning_rate` without early stopping; records energy density immediately prior to each update; and returns the exact required NumPy dictionary keys without printing.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation errors were found. Pauli indices (`1=X`, `2=Y`, `3=Z`), open-boundary bond ranges (`0..n_qubits-2`), staggered detuning signs `(-1)^i`, gate ordering (`rz(gamma)` then `ry(beta)` then `rz(alpha)` to yield `RZ(alpha) RY(beta) RZ(gamma)|psi>`), expectation value normalization, and scan/update ordering are all mathematically and programmatically sound.
